This input cell contains 16 atoms with the declared composition Eu₂Cu₄Sn₂S₈.

Thus the standard c axis corresponds to the input c direction, while the standard a and b axes are obtained from the difference and sum of the input a and b directions, respectively.

The representative Eu atom lies at (0, 0, 0.4779169999999999), so the single independent positional parameter is z = 0.4779169999999999. The other two sulfur sublattices are distinct fourfold 4b orbits, both of the form (1/4, y, z). The first has representative position (0.25, 0.3996584999999999, 0.18667750000000005), with y = 0.3996584999999999 and z = 0.18667750000000005. The second has representative position (0.25, 0.05872250000000001, 0.23556349999999995), with y = 0.05872250000000001 and z = 0.23556349999999995.

Taken together, these independent orbits generate four Eu atoms, eight Cu atoms, four Sn atoms, and sixteen S atoms in the conventional standard cell, while the supplied input cell contains Eu₂Cu₄Sn₂S₈. No precision corrections are listed; the coordinates are to be understood at the stated rounding precision of six digits where applicable.
